title: Clarify the unshipped satellite configuration prerequisite in onboarding documentation
outcome: The onboarding guide accurately distinguishes the implemented verification foundation from the missing operator satellite-role configuration workflow and satellite-side Engram opt-in.
acceptance: The onboarding brief explicitly states that this foundation does not provide a shipped operator surface for satellite-role configuration or initial satellite-side Engram opt-in.

The guide distinguishes operator provisioning, central enrollment and the satellite configuration prerequisite without presenting fixture-only setup as a currently executable end-to-end operator procedure.
The guide links to the satellite configuration follow-up workflow or clearly identifies the remaining workflow if it has not yet been designed.
